item.title: Splat 1.0.9
item.description:
- **A folder of notes in the sidebar:** see all notes around a document, search them, find the links to a note, and rename it together with those links (**View › Show Files**, ⌃⌘E; **Search All Notes…**, ⇧⌘F). - **Changes since the last commit:** in a Git repository, bars beside the text mark what differs, in both panes. - **Paste as Markdown** (⌃⌘V): formatted text from a browser, Word or Confluence arrives as Markdown, cells from a spreadsheet as a table. - **Import Word documents** with their images, formulas and footnotes (**File › Import Word Document…**). - **Export Options:** page numbers, header, footer and a title page for PDF and print, a title page and your company's template for Word. - **Word count** in the corner of the window, also for the selection, with reading time. - **A form for metadata:** a click on the metadata line in the preview, or **Format › Edit Metadata…**. - **Help** has new items: **Report a Problem…** opens a form on GitHub with the versions of Splat and macOS and the kind of Mac filled in, **Suggest a Feature…** opens one for ideas, and **Splat on GitHub** opens the project page. - The update dialog now shows what a new version brings. - **PDF export** draws SVG images and formulas with krilla instead of the discontinued svg2pdf: color emoji, repeating gradients and `\style` colors now appear. - **Fixed:** after a jump far down a freshly opened document, the preview stopped short of the place the source showed.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
